The upstream tag v1.37.1^{} resolves to f78e722, as the plan says. I used the proxy zip k8s.io/apimachinery@v0.37.1 instead of cloning, with Go 1.26.0 fetched through GOTOOLCHAIN.

The start has no vendor directory, and the module cache holds only klog, kube-openapi, streaming and utils. A grep of the module cache for CreateTwoWayMergePatch found nothing.
- Start score: a test that imports the strategicpatch package fails with a setup error, so every case fails.
- Golden generation: a Go program (/work/am/gold/main.go) builds 20 random object trees, and runs CreateTwoWayMergePatch, CreateThreeWayMergePatch and StrategicMergePatch on them with the reference. I ran it 3 times. The patch and result lines matched in all three runs. One run's three-way conflict error text differed from the other two, which I traced to map-order text in the error message; I did not check whether the conflict outcome itself changed.

full_card.band: 8h. Rebuilding about 3k lines of tightly coupled merge logic. A frontier agent that recalls upstream may reach a middle band; a weaker model likely fails the directives and three-way conflict logic. No dated public evidence of agent results on this exact task.
full_card.build_cost: About 2-3 days: strip snapshot and vendor copies, rebuild a warmed module cache for the staging module's deps, write oracle harness, golden corpus, and generator. The smoke probe was run against the root monorepo, not the staging module, so its red verdict is a probe-scope problem and does not show the task is unbuildable.
full_card.deliverable: Go package strategicpatch rebuilt to the public API: CreateTwoWayMergePatch, CreateThreeWayMergePatch, StrategicMergePatch and the LookupPatchMeta variants, with merge keys, the four directives, and struct-tag and OpenAPI metadata.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Grader-only oracle and generated cases are not in the image. Close the vendor/ and GOMODCACHE copy paths by stripping them, and forbid edits to test files and go.mod. The real package is the differential oracle, so the grader must hold it and it must not be in /app.
full_card.grading_surface: Upstream-derived table cases (YAML inside patch_test.go, count not yet taken) plus hidden generated random object trees, scored as fraction passed on patch bytes and result, with a differential oracle run offline by the grader.
full_card.local_fit: Go, CPU only, offline. Module build and tests fit 8 cores and 16 GB. No kernel features needed.
full_card.lookup: Complete public implementation exists (upstream Go module and tag, 2,871 importers). Recall in outline is likely; byte-exact recall of about 2k lines is unlikely. Git history is removed by the history-less snapshot.
full_card.provenance: kubernetes/kubernetes v1.37.1 (tag commit f78e722), staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/strategicpatch (patch.go 2253 lines, patch_test.go 7061 lines), Apache-2.0, published on pkg.go.dev with 2,871 importers.
full_card.reference: Upstream strategicpatch package at the tag commit (about 2k code lines in patch.go plus meta, types and errors). Scores 1.0 by definition; held out of the image.
full_card.ships: History-less snapshot of staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery with strategicpatch (and jsonmergepatch) removed, plus every vendor/ copy and the Go module cache stripped of any strategicpatch code. No network at run time.

spike_plan.kill_if: A copy of strategicpatch survives in vendor trees or the module cache and cannot be stripped without breaking the rest of the module; or the reference's own tests are nondeterministic or fail offline.
spike_plan.pass_if: Reference passes its own strategicpatch tests three times with identical results; the stripped module builds offline; no copy of strategicpatch survives in the snapshot, vendor trees or module cache; golden outputs are stable across reruns.
steps: In a throwaway networked container, fetch kubernetes at tag v1.37.1 and confirm it resolves to f78e722; record the pin.
Extract staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery into a scratch module, keep strategicpatch and jsonmergepatch intact, and run go test on strategicpatch with network to warm the module cache.
Run the upstream strategicpatch tests three times; confirm pass counts and per-test results are identical each run (determinism).
Count the YAML cases embedded in patch_test.go to size the grading surface.

Strip strategicpatch and jsonmergepatch from the snapshot, every vendor/ tree, and the module cache; then grep the stripped snapshot and cache for CreateTwoWayMergePatch and StrategicMergePatch. Any hit is a cheat path to close.
Rebuild the stripped module offline with GOPROXY=off and GOFLAGS=-mod=mod; confirm it builds and that the untouched start fails every case (score 0).
Generate 20 random object trees, record reference outputs as golden files, and rerun to confirm byte-identical output.

v1.summary: The upstream strategicpatch package is real and confirmed at the v1.37.1 tag (pinned commit f78e722, not the seed's a0788855 head), Apache-2.0, and public with 2,871 importers, so it has a strong paper trail but is also recallable in outline. The task is not killed, but it needs a spike to confirm that vendor and module-cache copies can be stripped and that a frontier agent lands mid-range, since no dated evidence exists for Band.

v2.note: Best of the batch. Confirmed: patch.go is about 2k code lines with the four directives, and patch_test.go is 7k lines of table cases (a good local self-check). The upstream package works as a differential oracle with a generator over typed and OpenAPI-meta object trees. Pin f78e722. Strip strategicpatch and mergepatch from GOMODCACHE and vendor trees. The generator needs struct types with patchMergeKey/patchStrategy tags. The jsonmergepatch scope is small, so buckets come from directives, two-way vs three-way, and meta sources. The red probe was run at monorepo scope and does not show the task is unbuildable.
